hints.title: Reverse Decoding Simulation
hints.text: Determine the total length of the fully decoded string first without physically expanding characters.

hints.title: Modulo Coordinate Wrapping
hints.text: When moving backwards, wrapping k modulo current length maps the target into an earlier repetition block.

hints.title: Backward Letter Encounter
hints.text: Reduce size by dividing on digits and subtracting on letters. If k is zero and a letter is encountered, return that character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of encoded string s
complexity.notes: Forward total length calculation followed by backward modulo reduction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing the decoded string directly consumes up to 2^63 characters of memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoid physical string expansion by tracking virtual length and reversing with modulo.
